Package com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp

Class SnmpV3Usm

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.snmp.SnmpV3Usm
public final class SnmpV3Usm extends Object
Pure mapper from a SnmpV3Config to the SNMP4J User-based Security Model (USM) primitives a v3 session needs: the authentication / privacy protocol OIDs, the SecurityLevel integer, and a localizable UsmUser. SNMP4J's own USM then does the key localization, authentication and privacy on the wire — this class only translates the config shape, it performs no crypto.

Everything here is deterministic and offline-testable: the protocol enums map to fixed SNMP4J OIDs (AuthMD5.ID, AuthSHA.ID, AuthHMAC192SHA256.ID for SHA-256, and PrivDES.ID / PrivAES128.ID for privacy), and each SnmpV3Config.SecurityLevel maps to the matching SecurityLevel.* constant.

  • Method Details

    • authProtocolOid

      public static org.snmp4j.smi.OID authProtocolOid(SnmpV3Config.AuthProtocol protocol)
      Maps a config authentication protocol to its SNMP4J auth OID, or null for SnmpV3Config.AuthProtocol.NONE (noAuth). SHA-256 is carried by HMAC-192-SHA-256.

    • privProtocolOid

      public static org.snmp4j.smi.OID privProtocolOid(SnmpV3Config.PrivProtocol protocol)
      Maps a config privacy protocol to its SNMP4J privacy OID, or null for SnmpV3Config.PrivProtocol.NONE (noPriv).

    • securityLevel

      public static int securityLevel(SnmpV3Config.SecurityLevel level)

    • securityName

      public static org.snmp4j.smi.OctetString securityName(SnmpV3Config cfg)
      The USM security name (username) as an OctetString; never null.

    • toUsmUser

      public static org.snmp4j.security.UsmUser toUsmUser(SnmpV3Config cfg)
      Builds a SNMP4J UsmUser from cfg. The auth / privacy protocols and passphrases are only populated when the configured security level actually requires them, so a noAuthNoPriv user carries no protocols and an authNoPriv user carries no privacy protocol — matching what SnmpV3Config.validate() enforces.
